RegistrationInfo.Description: APEX market window (apex-moc 2026-09-17 scheduler-not-a-service decision, option B). Launches the backend without --reload for the whole NYSE session plus the EOD jobs; the script gates on the ET clock (start 08:15-15:30 ET, stop 16:40 ET) so only one of the two triggers runs per day across DST-mismatch weeks. CHECK 80 counts cycles per session against the calendar. Interruption recovery: the 14:20 trigger repeats every 5 min to 22:40 (2026-10-03) — IgnoreNew drops a repeat while the instance runs (event 322), and once it has ended for any reason (uvicorn exit, HUP, console close 0xC000013A) the next repeat relaunches. RestartOnFailure does NOT relaunch on a non-zero action exit: measured 2026-10-03, exit 1 and 0xC000013A both logged event 102 (completed), no relaunch; it stays only for launch failures. A host reboot mid-window is covered by the LogonTrigger (the ET guard and port probe make every relaunch a no-op when nothing is missing). Recovery: delete this task; eod_window.sh remains as the EOD fallback.
